title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Join the checkout team as a junior software engineer. You will build and test payment features in Python and TypeScript, review code with your team and take part in a supported on-call rotation. 0-2 years of professional experience. English required; Dutch is a plus. Start date: January 2027.
reason: An entry-level role in the Python and TypeScript stack you used in your internship, with tests and a supported on-call rotation, and Dutch is a plus.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build and run the services behind our merchant dashboard in Python and Go. Experience with Kubernetes and PostgreSQL required. Hybrid, three days a week in our London office.
reason: Python services and tests match your internship, but it wants Kubernetes experience beyond basic Docker.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: Work on the rider app for our bike-sharing service with a squad of six engineers and a designer. React, TypeScript and a Python API. Git and code review every day. German B2 required.
reason: React, TypeScript and Python in a squad of six is a good first job, and your good German may just reach the B2 they ask for.

title: Backend Developer Intern
description: Six-month internship in the software team of a warehouse robotics company. Build REST services in Python, write tests and help with deployments. You must be enrolled at a university for the whole internship.
reason: The backend work fits, but this internship needs you enrolled at a university and you graduate in 2026.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Help build our news reader app. You will work on the TypeScript front end and the Python API behind it, and write tests. Fluent German required.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Lead the design of our patient booking services. At least 7 years of backend experience in healthcare or B2B SaaS. You will mentor three engineers and own the on-call rotation.
reason: A senior role asking for at least seven years of backend experience, well past your five-year limit.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Build and monitor the pipelines that feed our reporting. Python and SQL, with Airflow and Docker taught on the job. A solid first step into data engineering for developers who like SQL.
reason: Data engineering is your second choice, and Python, SQL and Docker pipelines are a sound first step from your internship.

title: Graduate Software Engineer Programme
description: Two-year rotational programme across our shipping, customs and billing platforms. The next intake opens in autumn.
reason: A graduate engineer programme in Rotterdam across logistics software like your internship.

title: Data Scientist
description: Build pricing models and maintain our feature store. Strong machine learning and statistics required, with Python. Spanish and English.
reason: A data science role built on machine learning and statistics, which isn't your background, and it needs Spanish.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Join our savings app team. You will build and test features in Python and TypeScript, review code and pair with senior engineers every week. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
reason: The stack and the pairing with senior engineers are a close match, but there is no visa sponsorship, so check your right to work in the UK.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build the APIs behind our lesson-planning tool, write tests and ship with a small team. Python and basic SQL needed; some AWS experience helps and we teach the rest.
reason: A small team, Python APIs and tests fit your internship, and the only gap is some AWS experience.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build and run the services behind our merchant dashboard in Python and Go. Experience with Kubernetes and PostgreSQL required. Hybrid, three days a week in our London office.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: Small team building a marketplace for independent bookshops. You will own the seller onboarding flow end to end, from the React screens to the Python API. Start date: March 2027.
reason: A small team where you would own seller onboarding end to end in your stack, and the March 2027 start fits your plans.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: Write and maintain the control software for our picking robots in C++ and Rust. Five years of professional experience required.
reason: Asks for five years of C++ and Rust, which is at your five-year limit and far from your Python and TypeScript.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Answer customer tickets, walk clinics through our booking software and escalate bugs to the developers. No coding is needed. Customer service experience preferred.
reason: Mostly answering customer tickets, which is support work you don't want, even though the title says engineer.

title: Software Engineer (Internship)
description: Twelve-week summer internship in our engineering team. Open to recent graduates. You will ship one feature from idea to release.
reason: Shipping one feature from idea to release is useful, but a twelve-week internship is a step back after your degree.
